## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm verify:pack` when package contents or public APIs changed
- [ ] Tests cover malformed input and offline/cache behavior where relevant
- [ ] A Changeset is included for a user-visible change
- [ ] No project code, lifecycle scripts, private dependency data, or internal specifications were added

## Compatibility and security

List report-schema, CLI, cache, provider, or security-boundary changes. Write `None` when not applicable.
